summary: The entity kind predicate at vtable slot 5Ch: all 88 compiled class-test bodies decoded byte for byte from .text with the literal set each accepts, all 1976 slot-5Ch call sites located, and the 63 query literals the engine asks with mapped to the classes that answer them.

literals.meaning: every entity except the effect/wreck branch under 37h and the 4Ch tool branch
the commandable/simulated family: units, weapon devices, ordnance, squadrons, convoys
a unit or a weapon device
a unit: every ship, plane, land vehicle, fort, command building, airfield and shipyard
a submarine; selects hull-body mode 2 at 00937CFD
a carrier (MMothership); the carrier arm of the air-operations split
a level bomber; the levelbomb/divebomb discriminator
a land structure: fort or command building
nothing: no class test carries 1Fh and no constructor stamps it
a turning gun: RT, ST and the depth-charge launcher
an ST gun or a depth-charge launcher
a bomb platform, single or multiple
ordnance: the MBomb family, including torpedoes, rockets, mines and paratroopers
an unnamed unit-family class, asked beside 06h in the surface-target test
an unnamed member of the 37h effect family
an unnamed root-derived class asked beside Path
an unnamed 02h-derived class asked beside Path

call_sites.note: hull-body mode word at [ESP+0ACh]: 2 for a submarine, else 1, dropped to 0 by the 00937D16-00937D38 float compare
first of six guards on the command task operand

device owner triple, first test: a unit. Four sibling routines repeat the triple at 0077F37D, 0077F40D, 0077F49D and 0077F532; Ghidra has no function at any of them, so they are not part of this body (0077F2D0-0077F354)
device owner triple, second test: a command building
device owner triple, third test: a land structure
surface target: the unnamed unit class 35h
the gun asks the turning-gun family of itself before allocating the aim bot
MRTGun-only arm of the turret aim step
fixed-gun arm of the shot spawn
ST-gun / depth-charge-launcher arm of the shot spawn
carrier arm of the air-base release
narrowing cast of bot+50h; ECX is null when it fails, guarding the 0090318D block
narrowing of [arg+28h] stored into bot+50h; true takes vtable[12Ch], false passes 1
second marker arm; 1Fh is accepted by no class, so the arm is unreachable
first of two consecutive 1Fh tests, never true

direct_calls.note: BSP_GunBot_AttachTurretClass forwards its argument to BSP_GunBot_Attach, then copies bot+50h to bot+68h

call_site_census.method: linear capstone sweep of .text collecting every CALL <reg> whose register was last defined by MOV <reg>,[<base>+5Ch]; the argument is the last PUSH before the call. No CALL dword ptr [reg+5Ch] exists in the image.

coverage.class_test_bodies: complete: 88 of 88 decoded from MOV EAX,[ESP+4] to RET 4 with no unexpected instruction
coverage.accepted_literal_sets: complete: decoded from each compare run, not derived from the class tree
coverage.agreement_with_entity_class_ids: complete: all 87 class rows of reports/entity_class_ids.json agree exactly
coverage.call_sites_located: complete for the compiled form MOV <reg>,[<base>+5Ch] + CALL <reg>: 1976 sites
coverage.query_literal_per_site: 1739 of 1976 literal, 234 computed and unresolved, 3 a different virtual
coverage.literal_to_class_set: complete for all 63 literals that appear at a call site
coverage.literal_meaning: partial: from the accepting set for all 63, plus the 40 reader rows here; the other callers were counted, not read
coverage.containing_function: partial: verified against live Ghidra bodies for the call_sites rows only; the per-literal caller counts use the nearest preceding function start
coverage.host_methods_required: complete: none, no class-test body contains a CALL
coverage.c4h_stamps: partial: 92 immediate stamps decoded; the 35 register-form stores were checked for an immediate source, not traced to producers

corrections.was: IsKindOf(02h) is the base of every scene entity
corrections.is: 02h is accepted by 52 of 87 classes; LandingPoint 1Dh, Stationary 36h, Wreck 3Bh, Cloud 3Dh, NavPoint 41h, MovieCamPos 42h, MovieCamLookat 43h, Landscape 44h, Path 47h, CameraPath 4Ah and MBullet 29h all answer it false. The unit gate is 05h
corrections.evidence: the accepted sets of all 88 bodies

corrections.was: 009030C0 row 1: piVar8 = bot+50h unless gun->IsKindOf(5) fails
corrections.is: no gun-family class (1Eh, 20h-28h) carries 05h, so if bot+50h is the gun the test cannot succeed and the 0090318D block is dead. Provisional: the attach paths into this bot class were not enumerated
corrections.evidence: the accepted sets of 006E3D50, 006FDE40 and the seven gun classes; 00903164-0090317B
